Self-tests of the two corpus runners. tests/parity.rs (native) and
parity/run.mjs (Node) each judge every row before they run the corpus,
and fail if a row's outcome is not its expect value. Each row:
name      human label.
case      a corpus case (see corpus.json), read with the case schema;
caseText  or the case as JSON text, which each runner parses itself, for
rows about the text: numbers as written, unpaired surrogates,
repeated members, whitespace, nesting depth.
saved     optional: {name: string}, the values earlier cases saved, for
the case's ${name} body strings.
bytes     optional: the exact request text the case submits.
response  optional: a response document the case is judged against with
its error and checks (not onWasm); its save paths must then
address strings in it.
expect    pass   - the case follows the schema, and it submits bytes and
is satisfied by response, where those are given;
fail   - the case follows the schema, and it submits other
bytes or response does not satisfy it;
reject - the case does not follow the schema, or its text does
not parse.
